name: waynestate/booster
description: WELD's upgrade tool: plans and runs PHP and Laravel upgrade hops on top of Rector, using CREED's version policy.

scripts-descriptions.ci: Run every CI check: manifest, tests, style, static analysis, audit, hop data freshness, agent-ready files, the Real output page, docs site
scripts-descriptions.site:agent-ready: Rewrite the Markdown twins, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, robots.txt and sitemap.xml in site/ (Squire's agent-ready kit).
scripts-descriptions.site:agent-ready-check: Fail when the agent-ready files are stale, a page lacks its Markdown link, a prompt drifts from the docs, or the kit was edited here.
scripts-descriptions.docs: Build the documentation site in site/docs/ from docs/ (Squire's docs kit).
scripts-descriptions.docs:check: Fail when the committed pages in site/docs/ drift from docs/, or a page references an image that is missing.
scripts-descriptions.proof: Rewrite site/proof.html, the Real output page, from the captured output in site/proof-data.
scripts-descriptions.proof:capture: Re-run Booster on every example app and re-capture site/proof-data (needs Docker; then run composer proof).
